$comment: typescript-angular generator options. Every model, enum and API service under
src/app/core/api/generated is produced from openapi.json by `npm run api:generate`,
which runs automatically before build, serve, test and lint. Nothing in that directory
ngVersion drives which Angular idioms the output uses: inject() over constructor
injection, HttpClient over the removed HttpClientModule, and standalone-friendly
providers. It must track the Angular version in package.json.
$comment-providedInRoot: Services are @Injectable({providedIn: 'root'}) so a component can inject
ListingsService directly. The alternative is an NgModule to import, which this app
does not have — it is standalone throughout.
$comment-useSingleRequestParameter: One object argument per operation instead of positional parameters. The public search
takes around twenty optional filters; as positional arguments that is a call site
nobody can read and a silent break the first time the backend adds a filter in the
$comment-stringEnums: Real TypeScript string enums, so a value can be referenced as ErrorCode.RATE_LIMITED
and a Record<ErrorCode, string> is exhaustive — which is what makes the French message
table fail to compile when the backend adds a code. 'original' naming keeps the
SCREAMING_SNAKE member names the API actually sends, rather than PascalCasing them
into something that no longer matches the wire.
